nativeValidation.setup: Use a short, clean, non-production checkout at the stated revision on delino-win-1. Run at the repository root in a non-elevated shell. Run the first command, copy files.copyFrom to files.copyTo, then run the second command. Preserve both test logs and console output.
expectedResults: The script confirms the revision and Windows PowerShell 5.1. All selected tests pass without skips.
Public Sync removes the seeded single deletion and the first and later U+FEFF deletions at their exact paths. The unlisted note.txt survives and removed paths are absent from the manifest.

Production PowerShell apply removes old files and empty directories at the first and later U+FEFF replacement and prune paths. Reapplying the same lists preserves existing replacement directories and their guest files.

For both link lists, the original files at the exact paths are removed. On this non-elevated host both link creations fail, yielding two SANDRUN-LINK-FAILED diagnostics per case. If creation succeeds the fixture verifies the actual link target.
The ASCII public Sync retry control passes initial replacement, retry after the manifest write failure, and termination on ordinary deletion failure. It uses Windows tar.exe and requires no junction.
limits: Successful native symbolic-link creation requires a Windows account whose PowerShell can create symbolic links. The non-elevated run validates exact path handling and failure reporting.
The revised Unicode fixtures exercise the list readers with no archive payload. End-to-end Unicode PAX extraction remains an independent native runtime limit on the reported host.
